title: Don’t Worry, Avatar: Seven Havens Won’t Dump All Its Episodes at Once
content: Avatar: Seven Havens will be making its official streaming debut later this year, but thankfully the series won’t be dropping all of its episodes at once as previously reported so fans can breathe easy.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Finally Streams a Classic Anime’s Missing Episodes After 13 Years
content: 13 years after they originally released, Crunchyroll has finally locked down an official streaming release for a classic anime’s episodes that were previously exclusive to Japan.
author: ComicBook

title: Konosuba Season 4 First Look Trailer Reveals Major Changes Behind the Scenes
content: Konosuba is now in the works on Season 4 of the anime at last, and fans have finally gotten the first look at what to expect from the new episodes. Konosuba: God’s Blessing on this Wonderful World!
author: ComicBook

title: The Transformers: The Movie Screens in U.S., U.K. With 'New Post-Credits Chapter' on September 17
content: Fathom Events and Hasbro announced on Friday that their upcoming 4K re-release of The Transformers: The Movie in theaters in the United States and United Kingdom on September 17 (" Transformers Day") will feature extra footage in the form of a never-before-seen "cinematic chapter" that will screen after credits.
author: ANN

title: 'Oni no Hanayome' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kureha 's Oni no Hanayome ( The Ogre's Bride ) novel announced additional cast on Sunday. The anime series premiered on July 5 at 12:30 a.m. on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV, and Tochigi TV, followed by CBC TV, Yomiuri TV, and other stations.
author: MyAnimeList

title: KonoSuba Season 4 Reveals Key Visual, Studio Change, 2027 Release
content: KonoSuba: God’s Blessing on This Wonderful World Season 4 revealed a new key visual, along with a 2027 release date and main staff. The new sequel was first announced after the BONUS STAGE OVA episodes on March 14, 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Ogre's Bride Anime Casts Akira Ishida, Misato Fukuen
content: The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's The Ogre's Bride ( Oni no Hanayome ) light novel series revealed on Sunday that Akira Ishida and Misato Fukuen have been added in the anime's cast. The new cast members' characters appeared in the anime's fourth episode on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Star Detective Precure! Anime Film Reveals Main Trailer, Staff Members, Ending Song
content: The staff for Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — revealed the film's main trailer and staff members on Sunday.
author: ANN
